name: labs/akperuht__pydaq
title: Digimess PN300 power supply
intro: Digimess PN300 power supply, adapted from akperuht/pydaq. It reads `protection`, `measured_voltage` and `measured_current`; sets `output`, `source`, `operating_mode`, `source_type` and 2 more; runs `output_off`. `output_off`: disable the power supply output (the declared safe state). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/akperuht__pydaq --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/akperuht__pydaq --backend fake --mcp
